usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve the current configuration of a specific SDN DNS provider object (e.g., PowerDNS) by its identifier. Requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on the /sdn/dns/{dns} path — typically held by administrators. SDN must be enabled on the cluster and the DNS object must already exist; use list_cluster_sdn_dns to enumerate available identifiers first.

examples.summary: Read configuration for an SDN DNS provider named 'pdns1'

tips: The dns identifier must start with a letter, end with a letter or digit, and contain only alphanumeric characters (min length 2).
This is a cluster-level read — it queries the cluster configuration database, not a specific node, so any online cluster member can serve it.
After modifying an SDN DNS object, call POST /cluster/sdn to apply pending changes cluster-wide before they take effect in the data plane.
